Ads are about to launch on Apple Maps in the US and Canada, and businesses can start booking ad slots from today. Below are the relevant details, including limited-time offers for businesses.

Businesses can book Apple Maps ads starting today

If you're a business owner looking to advertise on Apple Maps, the booking service officially opens today.

Although users won't see the ads actually go live just yet, Apple has opened up bookings to businesses in preparation for the full rollout.

Complete information on ad bookings has been uploaded to Apple's official website, with detailed steps on how to get started.

Apple has also launched a limited-time offer, with details as follows:

Eligible businesses that book a Maps ad with credit card payment by October 11, 2026 can enjoy this offer.

Earlier reports have mentioned that ads will appear in two locations on Apple Maps:

  • Before a user searches: "Recommended places" on the search screen will display business ads.
  • After a user searches: When search results are related to keywords, map ads will appear.

If you're considering placing an ad on Apple Maps, Apple also has a dedicated page explaining their advertising policy, click here for details.

Apple says its Maps records more than 10 billion merchant-related searches per month, with every two merchant searches leading to one user taking action. Additionally, according to the GWI Core Study for Q1 2025, 57% of Apple Maps users are Gen Z and Millennials.
